system.description:
Play the Tactician if you want to coordinate and inspire allies.

Features

Battlefield Orders. Choose two stratagems from below. You can mark a Stress to use them when the conditions are met.

  • Aim True! Before an ally makes an attack roll, they apply your Instinct or Wits modifier to the attack roll.
  • Press On! When the ally makes a successful attack, they also force the target to mark a Stress.
  • Shield Wall! When an ally would take Severe damage, they can mark a Stress to reduce the threshold.
  • Hold the Line! When the ally would be moved against their will, they may choose not to be moved.

Follow My Lead. Once per Rest, you can initiate a Stunt with an ally without either of you spending Hope.
